concepts.quote: An all-zero row is fine; it just means the page has no links.
concepts.why: This states the listed wrong rule that a page with no outgoing links can have an all-zero row; such a row must hold 1/N in every entry. Also, this page has links (outDegree 5).
Every row must be a probability distribution that sums to 1, so an all-zero row is not acceptable. This is the listed misconception.
